target_customer: Developers building agent powered products who do not want to build their own agent runtime
problem: Teams must rebuild runtime infrastructure (sessions, sandboxes, streaming, files, tracing) to run agent harnesses such as Codex or Claude Code inside their product.
business_model: Managed cloud usage plus an open source Apache 2.0 community edition
product_category: Agent infrastructure, unified API for agent harnesses

founders.name: Richard Song
previous_startups: Epsilla (AI agent platform and vector database, YC S23)
founders.background_notes: Senior Director of Cloud Engineering at TigerGraph per YC page; other sources name other co-founders inconsistently, so only Song is listed

technical_complexity.rationale: Isolated sandboxes, streaming sessions and a protocol across several agent harnesses are standard infrastructure work with fast moving targets.

defensibility.rationale: An open protocol and open source edition invite copying, and harness vendors can ship their own APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established; the product appears to date from 2026 so the batch era judgment is uncertain.

market_need_then: The YC S23 listing belongs to Epsilla, a vector database and RAG platform for the 2023 LLM wave. The current HarnessRouter product addresses agent harness proliferation in 2026.

identity.logo: horizontal and mark logos in light and dark variants, design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, short declarative lines for engineers; Don't build the harness

rebrands.why: Inferred from the shared YC listing and founder; not stated by a source

branding.community_and_virality: Open source repository with about 4.4k stars per the company site; Product Hunt launches.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name, early brand with open source traction but little independent press.

pivots.from: Epsilla, open source vector database and RAG platform
pivots.to: HarnessRouter, unified API for agent harnesses
pivots.why: Not stated; Epsilla is the S23 company page for the same founder and the HarnessRouter listing likely supersedes it

outcome_analysis: The YC listing describes a three person team now building HarnessRouter, an open source protocol and managed cloud for agent harnesses, with a Qoder integration and a reported 4.4 thousand repository stars. Funding and revenue are not public, and the link to the earlier Epsilla company is only inferred, so no clear success or failure story is available.
notes: Unverified: Dealroom lists a 125K seed; aggregators list Epsilla pre-seed of about 0.5M (convertible note 2023-01, YC, Nivesha Ventures, Ride Wave Ventures) which belongs to the earlier company. Founder lists conflict across sources (Kuanze Ma, Ricki Qin, Eric Yang named elsewhere). Epsilla to HarnessRouter relationship is inferred, not sourced. No dated competitor sources for the batch era (search on Epsilla returned no comparisons). Education not found.
